totp-account-password.reason: Frozen Go loads users.totp_enabled in pwhash.CheckPassword but IMAP LOGIN/AUTHENTICATE ignores it, so a TOTP user's account password opens a session with no second factor. Rust refuses the account password of a user with totp_enabled (same NO Authentication failed reply as a wrong password); app passwords still work. The flag is read by the per-call account SELECT, before the verification cache.
